newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-DAVIES BACK IN WELSH CONTENTION.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DAVIES BACK IN WELSH CONTENTION.

text.p: Jonathan Davies could return to the Welsh side to face England at Cardiff Arms Park in the Five Nations championship next week after Arwel Thomas was ruled out on Wednesday with a knee injury.

Davies, who made his international debut against England in the same fixture 12 years ago, has appeared against Scotland and France as a replacement this season but has not started a Five Nations game since 1988 .
Welsh coach Kevin Bowring's alternative option is to move Neil Jenkins from full-back but he has a long list of other injury problems.

He intends to announce an enlarged squad on Thursday and delay announcing the team as long as possible to allow maximum recovery time for David Young (ankle), Christian Loader (knee), Rob Howley (shoulder), Gareth Thomas (ankle), Scott Gibbs (stiff neck), Ieuan Evans (hamstring), Scott Quinnell (neck) and Davies (ribs).
Lock Mark Rowley is already out with a broken wrist.
England may also have to make a change at number 10 after Paul Grayson suffered a groin injury playing for his club Northampton on Tuesday.
